name: When should I consider a floor level transition improvement project?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a floor level transition improvement project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a floor level transition improvement project if you notice unevenness between different flooring types, significant gaps, or if existing transition strips are damaged or missing. Tripping hazards, persistent drafts, or difficulty cleaning the floor due to unevenness are also strong indicators. Additionally, it's often a necessary step when installing new flooring over an existing subfloor that isn't perfectly level.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider improvement if you have uneven floors, damaged transitions, tripping hazards, or are installing new flooring over an unlevel subfloor.
